messages:
arjun: Quick sync — we need to lock down the Cloud Storefront offer packaging for the three cloud vendors. Legal asked for a sanitized EULA draft (no infra-sensitive language), product needs SKU-to-feature mapping, and eng needs final artifact tags (AMI/container). Can folks call out blockers? https://confluence.redwood/partners/cloud-storefront

marta: I started a checklist in Confluence and added a column for 'region availability' and 'trial entitlements'. dropping link in thread in 5. :white_check_mark:

kevin: Heads-up: GCP needs the test project IDs and a service account with roles/storage.objectViewer by EOD Wednesday or queue slips. Also need the container digest (sha256).

sasha: Re: legal — I attached a redline to the EULA, removed low-level infra references and added a data residency clause for EU regions. PTAL.

arjun: thanks sasha. legal-bot, can you confirm audit log requirements are covered in the redline?

legal-bot: audit:confirmed - redline includes r1,r2. Need explicit retention period (30/90/365) chosen by sales. Please confirm desired retention string.

marta: product vote: go with 90 days default, opt-in 365 on enterprise. i'll update the checklist SKU column to reflect that.

kevin: for the artifact tags, please use this pattern so we can track deploys: `storefront-v{semver}-{commit-short}-{region}` e.g. `storefront-v1.2.0-9f3a-us-west1`. I'll add a small CI job to publish container manifest with digests to the artifacts bucket.

arjun: perfect. @kevin can you also add a small script snippet for partners to verify digest? tiny example in thread would help.

kevin: sure — snippet below for partner verification:

```
# verify container digest
docker pull gcr.io/redwood/storefront:v1.2.0-9f3a-us-west1
docker inspect --format='{{index .RepoDigests 0}}' gcr.io/redwood/storefront@sha256:<digest>
```

sasha: product/legal question — does the EULA language allow us to show anonymized usage metrics on the public listing? we should be explicit.

arjun: yes but only aggregated and anonymized. i'll add a line in the redline to clarify 'no customer-identifying telemetry shown on public listing.'

marta: timeline check — if we finalize EULA + artifact tags by Thu, we can submit offers to the three stores Fri morning. internal QA window is Fri afternoon. any hard blockers?

kevin: no blockers from infra side if we get credentials and the digest today.

sasha: legal is good with the redline pending the retention string change (90d).

arjun: sweet. action items: marta = update checklist + SKU mapping, sasha = update EULA retention string, kevin = CI job + partner verification snippet, arjun = submit offers Fri morning. I'll post a final checklist link after updates. :rocket:

marta: copied. will ping if anything slips. :thumbsup:

kevin: adding Jira tasks now (#PART-421, #PART-422).

sasha: leaving a brief note for sales enablement so they don't promise 365 by default.

arjun: thanks team — we'll reconvene in this thread if anything changes.
